review:
Extra Chilli builds on Bonanza with a free spins gamble wheel – risk your spins for a chance at more. Unlimited multipliers remain the core. The 96.82% default RTP is among the best for a Megaways game.

In the base game Extra Chilli behaves like most Megaways titles: a lot of small cascades, occasional mid-sized hits when high-paying chillies line up, and long gaps between free spins. The gamble wheel is the defining decision. Spinning it can turn 8 free spins into 24, but a miss forfeits the bonus entirely, so the sensible choice depends on whether you want a steady bonus or a lottery ticket. Try both approaches in demo to see how much the outcomes vary.
cons: Gamble wheel can lose the bonus entirely
